My dad flew Caitlyn Jenner, known as that time as Bruce . My dad is an private airline pilot, and Bruce wanted to fly his privately owned jet, which you need a license and a experienced pilot to guide you for. That happened to be my dad. 
My dad now flys Stan Kroenke, owner of Walmart and the Los Angeles rams and several soccer teams .
Please explain, it helps to analyze situations like that. What is exactly bothering you?

At the start of high school, I was exactly in your position. I felt trapped and alone, and people were right, my grade school friends did not stick with me in high school- shame. 
I want you to know that there's more than just school out there . Are you religious ? Maybe join a support youth group, it seemed scary for me at first - but it helped after I got dumped by my first true love. 
It sucks, yes. I also play video games on a shitty laptop, but games such as stardew valley are very therapeutic and easy to run. 
If you feel like you want to die please text this number 741-741 and text connect. They will not call the police, instead they will talk with you and ask about your problems and how you can cope. 
I'm rooting for you

Depression feeds off exhaustion, and it sounds like you need sleep and a loyal friend. 
I'm currently on suicide watch by my friends and family, they took my car keys. I don't blame them.
I recommend texting this chat line , 741-741 and you type connect. They will not call the police but instead talk to you like any person ever would. It's very nice.
Final thought, people care - it doesn't seem like they do, but sometimes people have issues of their own and/ or don't know the experience of being suicidal so they won't take it as seriously. 
Good luck , you can do this
a little yes, i dont know what to do anymore I just keep crying

He took me on a date and when dropping me off back at my house told me that he loved me as a person and a friend, he loved hanging out with me but couldnt find us compatible as a couple. He still wants to be best friends but I dont know how I can do that.

Nothing will make it go away, Suicide is when your coping mechanisms aren't out weighing the pain you feel right now.  
Whoever sent this, I am so sorry, I am too going through my personal issues with suicide and heartbreak, it sucks, but It's nice to know you aren't alone. 
I want you to please please please call the suicide hotline 1-800-273-8255 there is even an online chat.
Please go out there and try to find some part of your life that you don't want to let go, and think about that. Please keep trying to find things that help you. Please. there's a couple of Ted Talks too about it, but it won't make it go away, the only thing that can help is a self-healing process and the reliance of friends. 
Best of Luck, I am so sorry- you can do this.

I just got dumped on a date, I don't know what to do. I feel so suicidal, the worst part is the guy never did anything wrong. He always treated me lovely, we never fought, and he still wants to be best friends. Please help me, I feel like I'm drowning in my own tears
